goals.objective: Execute the approved wise-combine-test plan end to end from the current worktree. Preserve the project requirements in AGENTS.md. Complete remaining runtime adapter/reporting and CLI/documentation/measurement work, with Linux C++20 build, tests, memory safety, user documentation, evidence, and atomic commits. Do not implement the explicitly forbidden parameter-sweeping completeness checker.

successCriteria.scenario: Run cmake -S . -B /tmp/wct-final-cxx20 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build /tmp/wct-final-cxx20 --parallel && (cd /tmp/wct-final-cxx20 && ctest --output-on-failure); PASS iff all registered tests pass and CLI/runtime artifacts exist.

Run the CLI/runtime failure matrix: malformed spec, adapter mismatch, malformed response, timeout, crash, output cap, and max_cases=0. PASS iff each returns its documented non-zero/status classification and writes a diagnostic report.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Runtime worker produced no new artifact and remained live beyond 80 seconds; existing independent evidence only covers the success fixture.
successCriteria.notes: Need a stable single worker session to implement and verify mismatch, malformed response, timeout, crash, output cap, allowlist, and JSON escaping.

successCriteria.scenario: Run the complete CTest suite from the C++20 build and sanitizer build. PASS iff smoke, model, spec, generator, and runtime tests all pass with no sanitizer diagnostics and no forbidden feature files appear.
